{{MissingInfo|1|java}} [[File:Madeleine AG093.png|thumb|220px|Madeleine with her Shroomish]] '''Madeleine''' is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG093|Clamperl of Wisdom]]'' who lives on [[Maisie Island]]. She did not have a name in the original version. While walking with her Pokémon, a {{OBP|Spoink|recurring}} {{m|Psychic}}ally placed her {{p|Shroomish}} on its head after it had lost its {{i|pearl}}. {{an|May}} immediately returned Shroomish to her with apologies, and the two promptly ran away. Later, while walking along the shore, Madeleine and her friend encountered the Spoink again. They held their [[Pokémon]] away from it, afraid that it would take their Pokémon again. Though they were relieved to see that Spoink had a blue pearl atop its head. Spoink suddenly fell, sending its blue pearl ricocheting through some rocks and being swapped by a {{p|Clamperl}}'s pink pearl in the process. The pair reported the incident to {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, pointing them to the Clamperl. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Madeleine |pkmn=Shroomish |type1=Grass |img=Madeleine Shroomish.png |epnum=AG093 |epname=Clamperl of Wisdom |desc={{p|Shroomish}} is one of the Pokémon that {{OBP|Spoink|recurring}} mistook for its {{i|pearl}} during its search. {{ashfr|The group}} quickly returned Shroomish to Madeleine and apologized for the incident. None of Shroomish's moves are known.}} ==Voice actresses== {{vatable|color={{grass color}}|bordercolor={{grass color light}} |ja=羽田千尋 ''Chihiro Haneta'' |en=[[Amy Birnbaum]] |fi=Susa Saukko |it=Laura Brambilla |pt_br=Gilmara Sanches}} ==Trivia== * Girls with the [[Animated series character recycling|same hairstyle and clothing]] as Madeleine had cameos in ''[[EP027|Hypno's Naptime]]'', ''[[AG084|Who's Flying Now?]]'', ''[[AG184|Strategy Tomorrow - Comedy Tonight]]'', and ''[[BW053|A Maractus Musical!]]''.
